description: Validate one SEPA XML document (pain.001.001.03 or pain.001.001.09). The file is uploaded to the free keyless API POST https://checksepa.com/v1/validate. Limits: 30 requests per IP per hour, 200 per UTC day, 2 MB. The file is not stored. Provide exactly one of file_path or xml. Returns valid, format, version, errors, and warnings. Each finding has code, message, path, and line.

file_path.description: Path to a SEPA XML file. Resolved by this process.

xml.description: SEPA XML as a string. Use this or file_path.

name: validate_sepa
title: Validate SEPA XML
